tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a web page or a PDF as clean Markdown (title, byline, main text, word count; PDFs up to 100 pages).

tools.name: shot
tools.description: Screenshot a web page as PNG (desktop 1440×900 or mobile 390×844; full page up to 8000 px).

tools.name: table
tools.description: Extract every <table> on a page as JSON arrays (or CSV).

tools.name: links
tools.description: Check every link on a page: HTTP status, final URL after redirects, ok/broken (max 200).

tools.name: seal
tools.description: Read a page as Markdown AND screenshot it from the same page load (JSON with markdown and a base64 PNG). Returns a responseHash you can pass to diff later.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Read a page or PDF and return the requested fields as JSON, each with the exact quote it came from (unknown fields come back null, never guessed).

tools.name: diff
tools.description: What changed on a page since an earlier seal of it: added and removed lines of the main text. Seal the page first, then pass that responseHash as since.

tools.name: token
tools.description: Facts about a Robinhood Chain token at one block: supply, owner(), burns, Pons stage and creator tax, deployer and its other launches, holder count and top 10 holders. No score, no advice.

tools.name: launches
tools.description: The newest token launches on Pons (Robinhood Chain) with deployer history, stage, holders and biggest wallet. No score, no advice.
